sys.scale: Midscale — feature-sliced SPA monolith on a managed BaaS
sys.architectural_pattern: Feature-sliced vertical modules under src/features/<domain>/, each owning its own Page components, presentational Cards, a <domain>Client.js data-access boundary, and a <domain>Helpers.js pure-logic layer. Cross-cutting concerns live in src/theme, src/components/common, src/utils, src/app.

ui_state.design_tokens: src/theme/themeFactory.js (palette, customShadows.elevated/soft), src/theme/responsiveTokens.js, mode via src/theme/ThemeModeProvider.js
ui_state.motion_library: none installed — framer-motion planned for src/theme/motion.js, gated on the existing useReducedMotionPreference hook

sprint.goal: Correctness-first overhaul of the admin/staff panels, then dark-mode token cleanup, user-facing copy cleanup, and a motion/design layer. Additive only — no schema edits, no breaking prop changes.

OPEN security: flagSearch + incident filters sit in loadPage's deps while `if (loading) return <LoadingScreen/>` gates the page — typing one character unmounts the search input

OPEN billing: sortBillingInvoices is descending but buildBillingSummary uses dueInvoices[0] as the next-billing fallback, picking the furthest-out invoice; negative unit_price/tax/discount unvalidated; manual Paid/Overdue status silently recalculated
OPEN plans: negative price clamped to 0 server-side instead of rejected; bundle-issue member selector filters by role but not is_active

OPEN staff: commission amounts and compensation rates unvalidated, inconsistent with saveOperatingExpense in the same service
